title: Zesty Crisp British Cherry Tomatoes Salad
description: A sweet and energizing British dish featuring cherry tomatoes with an al-dente finish, perfect for a light meal or snack, and is FODMAP friendly.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the halved cherry tomatoes, sliced cucumber, and thinly sliced red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, garlic-infused oil, salt, and black pepper to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the tomato mixture and toss to coat.
Sprinkle the chopped fresh parsley over the top of the salad and toss again to combine.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, give the salad a good stir and adjust the seasoning if necessary.
Serve the salad chilled, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
